heading: top-split
name: 等尺寸卡片網格＋右上相連分頁按鈕群組
desc: 上方左側標題組、右側一組相連的分頁按鈕；下方多個等寬等高的無外框卡片排成網格，最下方置中一顆按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方放標題組：標題靠左，右側放一組相連的分頁按鈕（按鈕群組），所有按鈕連成一條、共用一個底條，其中一顆為選取狀態，整組約佔內容寬度一半、靠右，與標題組垂直置中；標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，沒有時省略。標題組下方是多個項目排成的網格，對齊頁面內容寬度，每列四個；所有項目等寬等高、內容結構相同，文字長短不改變項目尺寸，標題過長時以省略號截斷，項目之間沒有分隔線。每個項目無外框：橫式圖片在上，所有圖片同一比例，下方是標題，再下方左側放次要文字、右側可放一組小標籤（可換行），沒有時省略。網格下方置中放一顆帶箭頭圖示的按鈕，沒有時省略。
mobile: 結構不變，等比縮放，但有以下變化：右上的分頁按鈕群組不顯示，標題組只留在上方靠左；網格改為每列兩個，顯示的項目數量較少，所有項目仍等寬等高；項目內的小標籤改到次要文字下方、直向排列；按鈕仍置中在網格下方。

en.name: Equal-size card grid + connected tab button group at top right
en.desc: A heading group at the top left with a connected group of tab buttons on the right; below, multiple equal-width, equal-height borderless cards in a grid, with one centered button at the bottom.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, with the title on the left and the description or button on the right: on the right sits a connected group of tab buttons (a button group), all joined into one strip on a shared base bar, with one button in the selected state; the group takes about half the content width, aligned right, and is vertically centered with the heading group. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above; omit it when there is no content. Below the heading group, multiple items form a grid aligned to the page content width, four per row; all items are equal in width and height with the same internal structure, text length never changes the item size, an over-long title is truncated with an ellipsis, and there are no dividers between items. Each item has no border: a landscape image on top, all images in the same ratio, a title below it, and below that secondary text on the left with an optional group of labels on the right (may wrap to multiple lines); omit them when there is no content. Below the grid, optionally place one centered button with an arrow icon; omit it when there is no content.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The structure stays the same and scales proportionally, with these changes: the tab button group at the top right is hidden, leaving only the heading group at the top left; the grid becomes two per row and shows fewer items, all still equal in width and height; the labels inside each item move below the secondary text and stack vertically; the button stays centered below the grid.
